description: Resque is a Redis-backed Ruby library for creating background jobs, placing them on multiple queues, and processing them later.

latest_release.name: v3.2.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Require same-origin requests for resque-web actions by @PatrickTulskie in https://github.com/resque/resque/pull/1980
* Version 3.2.0 by @PatrickTulskie in https://github.com/resque/resque/pull/1981


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/resque/resque/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0

hot_issues.title: QUEUE=* bundle exec rake resque:work will fail and not output any errors when redis has bad keys
rake resque:work aborts startup if the first job raises an uninitialized constant error
SIGABRT (signal 6) after a job is killed by the Linux OOM killer
Trigger events with ActiveSupport::Notifications when available
